_comment: Shared generated aggregates that a branch must never edit directly (tools/scripts/hotspot_edit_guard.py). Each was a top merge-conflict hotspot and now lives as one fragment per entry; a branch writes the fragment through `writer`, never the aggregate. Register a hotspot here only once its fragments exist, or every legitimate edit would be refused. A hotspot that was a literal repeated inside hand-written files registers `path` as a glob plus an `added_line_pattern`; only a change that adds a matching line is refused.

hotspots.why: 75 non-merge commits on main in one week, and the most conflicted file in the repository: every pull request that added or re-pointed a script test rewrote neighbouring lines of one generated document

every capability change that added, removed or re-reviewed a public header rewrote one sorted ledger, so two branches adding headers at neighbouring positions conflicted; it is now one record file per header
an append-only array: every recorded state was written at the same tail, so two branches always conflicted on its last lines; it is now one file per recorded state, chained by parent digest
236 copies of whole-header digests sat on catalog rows, one per binding, so one header edit rewrote every row naming it; each header's reviewed digest is now one fragment
